steps.title: Farther, yet summer
steps.say: Yes — northern summer happens when Earth is farthest from the Sun. So distance cannot be the cause.

ops.text:
Surprise: in July, northern summer,
Earth is FARTHER from the Sun.
So distance is not the cause.

steps.title: The tilt does it
steps.say: The axis leans toward the Sun, so sunlight hits the northern hemisphere more directly.

ops.text:
N pole leans
toward the Sun

steps.title: Why that heats more
steps.say: Direct sunlight concentrates energy, and longer days add more hours of heating.

ops.text: More direct sunlight + longer days = hotter.
